question: Merchandise Exports from India Scheme was launched in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Merchandise Exports from India Scheme (MEIS)** was launched in the year **2015** under the Foreign Trade Policy (2015-2020).
 
• This scheme was introduced by the Government of India to **boost the export of goods and products manufactured in India**.
 
• The primary objective of MEIS is to provide financial incentives for exporters, ensuring that Indian goods remain competitive in the international markets.
 
• Under MEIS, exporters receive **duty credit scrips** that can be used for paying customs duties, excise duties, and service tax.
 
• The MEIS scheme covers a wide range of products including agricultural goods, pharmaceuticals, textiles, and leather products&l
